note: Looks shipped with the Studio (#1221). Each is copied into the Workspace once, by id, and never overwritten there: the owner's edits and put-away looks stay as they are. A look is wording plus its recipe; the owner types only the scene. Picking one prepares Create and never generates.

body.template: No people. Hand-painted anime film background of {scene}. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark graphite wall, softly lit, almost empty and low in detail. Faint rose and cyan reflections on the wet surfaces, muted graphite palette with small amber accents. Nobody in the picture. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
body.scene_example: a narrow late-night apartment corridor; at the right edge a tall rain-streaked window shows the city at night and a distant elevated train crossing on a rail line, with a small wooden bench, a warm amber wall lamp and the soft cyan glow of a vending machine
body.source_prompt: An empty room, no people. Hand-painted anime film background of a narrow late-night animation workshop loft above a rain-washed city. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark graphite plaster wall, softly lit, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge a tall rain-streaked window shows the city at night and a distant elevated train crossing on a rail line; below it a small wooden desk with stacked blank drawing sheets, a warm amber desk lamp and a small glowing CRT monitor making a soft pool of cyan light. Faint rose and cyan reflections on the wet glass, muted graphite palette with small amber accents. An empty room with nobody in it. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
body.notes: From the accepted anchor's recipe (source_prompt, verbatim). The style, palette, camera and exclusion sentences are kept word for word; the place and its right-edge props became the scene. Keep the scene's detail at the right edge: the left half stays quiet for text. The lab carried this look to a corridor (keep) and a rooftop (fixable: busy left half) with the anchor's full sentence structure; this one-slot form has not been rendered yet. Z-Image Turbo takes no negative prompt, so the exclusions are in the wording. Run 2-4 seeds and judge the quiet left half first.
